Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Defines weapon upgrade levels: the attack, scaling, guard and SpEffect changes at each level and the upgrade cost (EquipMtrlSetParam ID offset and price rate). Rates are multipliers: 1 leaves the weapon's value unchanged.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base physical attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Energy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base energy attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base fire attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base lightning attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base stamina attack (stamina damage dealt to a guarding target) at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Poise
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poise damage at this level.

Fields.Name: Poise Durability
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poise (super armour) durability at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: STR
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Strength scaling at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: DEX
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Dexterity scaling at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: INT
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Intelligence scaling at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: FTH
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Faith scaling at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's physical guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Energy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's energy guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's fire guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's lightning guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: ACS Anomaly
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard cut rate against burning (ACS anomaly) attacks at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Stun
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard cut rate against stun attacks at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Plasma
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard cut rate against strong plasma attacks at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Curse
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard cut rate against curse attacks at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard boost (stamina defence when guarding) at this level.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 1 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 2 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 3 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 1 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 2 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 3 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Reinforcement Material Set ID to pick the EquipMtrlSetParam row of materials needed to upgrade to this level.

Fields.Name: Max Reinforcement Level
Fields.Description: Level value this row counts as for the maximum-upgraded-weapon level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Dark
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base dark attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Dark
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's dark guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: LCK
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Luck scaling at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Depleted Uranium
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard cut rate against depleted uranium poison attacks at this level.

Fields.Name: Reinforce Price Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Reinforcement Price for the upgrade to this level.

Fields.Name: Base Change Price Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's evolution (base change) price.
